text: The property experienced tree-cover loss in 2021, with an area of 81.3 hectares affected, representing about 2.23% of the total asset area. The lost tree cover was primarily planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species, with no native forest involved. Additionally, there were smaller patches of loss totaling 37.3 hectares that were not counted as part of the main event due to their size. The observations from Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020 corroborate the tree-cover loss event.
